description: This Java source file contains integration tests for the Loan Charge Off Accounting features within the Apache Fineract project. It tests various scenarios including periodic and cash-based accounting treatments for charge-offs, including handling of charge-off reasons, journal entries verification, and specific accounting rules such as goodwill credit and charge-off fallbacks. It uses JUnit 5 for testing and relies on the Fineract testing helpers to simulate loan operations and verify journal entries.

classes.name: LoanChargeOffAccountingTest
classes.description: Integration test class for verifying the accounting treatment of loan charge-offs including periodic and cash-based accounting modes.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the test environment before each test, setting up REST clients and test helper instances.

methods.name: loanChargeOffAccountingTreatmentTestForPeriodicAccrualAccounting
methods.description: Tests the accounting entries and loan status changes when a loan is charged off under periodic accrual accounting rules.

methods.name: loanChargeOffFraudAccountingTreatmentTestForCashBasedAccounting
methods.description: Tests the charge-off process and journal entries when a loan is marked as fraud and charged off under cash-based accounting rules.

methods.name: loanAccountingTreatmentTestForGoodwillCreditPeriodicAccrualAccounting_NoChargeOff
methods.description: Verifies journal entries for Goodwill Credit transactions in a periodic accrual scenario without charge-off.

methods.name: loanAccountingTreatmentTestForGoodwillCreditPeriodicAccrualAccounting_ChargeOff
methods.description: Verifies journal entries for Goodwill Credit transactions with charge-off in a periodic accrual scenario.

methods.name: loanAccountingTreatmentTestForCashBasedAccounting_NoChargeOff
methods.description: Verifies journal entries for Goodwill Credit under cash-based accounting without charge-off.

methods.name: loanAccountingTreatmentTestForCashBasedAccounting_ChargeOff
methods.description: Verifies journal entries when charging off a loan under cash-based accounting rules.

methods.name: noIncomeRecognitionAfterChargeOff
methods.description: Tests that no income recognition occurs after a loan is charged off, including handling business dates and accruals.

methods.name: advancedAccountingForChargeOff
methods.description: Tests advanced accountings for charge-offs including mapping to delinquent expense accounts and verifying journal entries.

methods.name: advancedAccountingForChargeOffFallbackToRegular
methods.description: Tests fallback scenario where advanced accounting mappings fall back to regular accounting entries.

methods.name: createLoanProductWithAdvancedChargeOffAccounting
methods.description: Creates a loan product with specific advanced charge-off accounting configurations including charge-off reason and expense account.
